$comment: What the tree expects of production's realtime tier (docs/CLOUDFLARE.md 3.7 item 4 and 5.6; scripts/hosting/README.md). The production guard (~/.config/turboslide/gt-follow.sh with the Cloudflare phase's patch) reads `realtime` from the checked out sha: `do` makes the three realtime rows join the seller path, deploys the Worker with every push and holds the sha while TURBOSLIDE_ROOM_HOST is absent from the production environment names; `blob` or no file checks nothing; `redis` is the tier that exists in code and is never deployed, so nothing writes it. `node scripts/hosting/realtime-env.mjs flip --tier do` writes do when it removes the forced TURBOSLIDE_REALTIME row and `rollback` writes blob; each is committed with the push that changes the environment. Hand edits follow the same rule: the value names the tier production selects after the environment change, never a wish.
